title: 第7章 通天眼第8章 赵锐凌
content_zh:
韩林看着手中石珠，暗暗震惊：“难道这石珠，竟是某位修行者，炼制的宝贝不成？”
他白天看过的修行入门手册上面，就粗略介绍了一些修行者使用的宝物，拥有各式各样的玄乎能力。
而这种宝物，大多是可以滴血认主的。
想到此处。
韩林心头不禁升起一抹期待之情，随后咬破食指，将几滴鲜血滴在了石珠表面。
“有变化了！”
就在韩林的注视下，那石珠表面的鲜血，竟在缓缓消失不见，仿佛被吸入石珠之中。
令韩林精神一振。
而且越来越快，四五个呼吸的功夫，便彻底消失的无影无踪。
与此同时，韩林也似乎感觉到，自己和这石珠之间有了某种联系，只是不怎么清晰。
“再来。”
韩林见状，又连续挤出几滴鲜血，滴在石珠表面。
这一次，石珠吸收的速度更快了，几乎转眼间，鲜血就被石珠吸收一空！
韩林感觉到，自己与石珠之间的联系，越来越紧密。
但正当他还要继续的时候。
异变却忽然发生了！
只见手中石珠，竟忽然摇身一变，化作一道银光朝他眉心飞了过来，根本不给他任何反应的机会。
等到韩林回过神时，那石珠已然不见了踪影。
他伸手摸了摸自己眉心，除了微微发烫之外，也没有任何不适，不由得有些傻眼。
“跑哪去了？”

韩林不知道的是，此刻他眉心位置，已然多出一条浅灰色竖纹，与石珠表面那道竖纹十分相似。
而正当韩林百思不得其解时，眉心竖纹忽然灵光一闪，无数斑杂的信息，朝他脑海中汹涌而来。
韩林只感觉脑袋里面一下被强行塞满了无数记忆，头昏脑涨，混乱不堪，直到好一阵子之后才回过神来。
满是震惊和不可置信。
“通天眼？”
根据这些突如其来的信息，韩林了解到，那颗消失的石珠，竟然是一颗天地间自然诞生的灵瞳。
名为通天之眼。
此瞳有两方面能力。
第一方面是时间加速，它能够释放出一种名为时间法界的东西。
初始阶段，在法界内修炼十天，外界才过去一天。
也就是十倍流速。
而且并非一成不变，还会随着通天眼的不断觉醒，跟着攀升。
而第二个方面，则是通天眼的根本能力。
包括洞察入微，看破幻象，洞悉天地规则，看因果，甚至断轮回，见前世今生…等等。
可谓相当玄乎。
只不过，这里面大部分能力，现在都无法动用，需要消耗各种珍贵资源强化通天之眼，才能逐步将其激活。
但尽管如此，如今具备的两个能力，也足够韩林惊喜不已了。
第一个能力，自然是通天法界的十倍时间加持，这或许能让他，打破九灵根无法突破练气一层的魔咒。
而第二个能力，则是洞察入微，据说可以看到很多别人看不见的东西。
看到此处。

韩林当即忍不住尝试了起来。
他按照那神秘信息的指引，静气凝神，然后将意念朝眉心位置汇聚，心中默念着“通天法界！”四个字。
嗡！
念头一起，眉心那道浅灰色竖纹，忽然亮了起来。
同时，一个洁白的半球形结界凭空闪现而出，将他笼罩其中。
content_en:
Han Lin looked at the stone bead in his hand and was secretly shocked: "Could this stone bead be a treasure refined by a certain cultivator?"
The introductory manual for spiritual practice he had read during the day briefly introduced some of the treasures used by practitioners, which possess various mysterious abilities.
Most of these treasures can be identified with a drop of blood.
Think of this.
Han Lin couldn't help but feel a sense of anticipation in his heart, then he bit his index finger and dropped a few drops of blood on the surface of the stone bead.
"There's been a change!"
Under Han Lin's gaze, the blood on the surface of the stone bead slowly disappeared, as if it was being sucked into the stone bead.
Han Lin was refreshed.
And it was getting faster and faster, and within four or five breaths, it completely disappeared without a trace.
At the same time, Han Lin seemed to feel that there was some kind of connection between himself and the stone bead, but it was not very clear.
"Come again."
Seeing this, Han Lin squeezed out a few drops of blood and dripped them on the surface of the stone beads.
This time, the stone beads absorbed it faster. Almost in the blink of an eye, all the blood was absorbed by the stone beads!
Han Lin felt that the connection between himself and Shi Zhu was getting closer and closer.
But just as he was about to continue.
A sudden change occurred!
He saw the stone bead in his hand suddenly transformed and turned into a ray of silver light flying towards his eyebrows, without giving him any chance to react.
By the time Han Lin came to his senses, the stone bead had disappeared.
He reached out and touched the center of his eyebrows. Apart from being slightly hot, there was no discomfort at all. He couldn't help but feel a little dumbfounded.
"Where have you gone?"
What Han Lin didn't know was that there was already a light gray vertical line between his eyebrows, which was very similar to the vertical line on the surface of the stone bead.
Just when Han Lin was puzzled, an idea suddenly flashed across the vertical lines between his eyebrows, and countless mixed information surged into his mind.
Han Lin felt like his head was being forcibly filled with countless memories. He was dizzy and confused. He didn't come back to his senses until a while later.
Full of shock and disbelief.
"The Eye of Heaven?"
Based on this sudden information, Han Lin learned that the missing stone bead was actually a spiritual pupil naturally born between heaven and earth.
It's called the Eye of Heaven.
This pupil has two abilities.
The first aspect is time acceleration, which can release something called the Time Realm.
In the initial stage, if you practice in the Dharma Realm for ten days, only one day will pass in the outside world.
That is ten times the flow rate.
And it is not static, it will also rise as the Babel Eye continues to awaken.
The second aspect is the fundamental ability of the Sky Eye.
Including insight into subtleties, seeing through illusions, understanding the rules of heaven and earth, seeing cause and effect, even breaking reincarnation, seeing past and present lives... and so on.
It's quite mysterious.
However, most of the abilities here cannot be used now. It is necessary to consume various precious resources to strengthen the Eye of Heaven in order to gradually activate it.
But despite this, the two abilities he now possesses are enough to surprise Han Lin.
The first ability is naturally the ten times time blessing of Tongtian Dharma Realm, which may allow him to break the curse that the Nine Spiritual Roots cannot break through the first level of Qi training.
The second ability is insight, and it is said that you can see many things that others cannot see.
See here.
Han Lin couldn't help but try it immediately.
Following the guidance of the mysterious message, he calmed down and concentrated, and then focused his thoughts towards the center of his eyebrows, silently reciting the four words "Connecting to the Dharma Realm!" in his heart.
Buzz!
As he thought together, the light gray vertical lines between his eyebrows suddenly lit up.
At the same time, a white hemispherical barrier flashed out of thin air and enveloped him.
